| **$\theta $** | $0$ | $\frac{\pi }{6}$ | $\frac{\pi }{3}$ | $\frac{2\pi }{3}$ | $\pi $ | $\frac{4\pi }{3}$ | $\frac{5\pi }{3}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $2$ | $\sqrt{3}$ | $1$ | $-1$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $1$ |
| $y$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ |

$$

$$

Now, we work out the $y$ values using $y=2\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta .$ This gives

| **$\theta $** | $0$ | $\frac{\pi }{6}$ | $\frac{\pi }{3}$ | $\frac{2\pi }{3}$ | $\pi $ | $\frac{4\pi }{3}$ | $\frac{5\pi }{3}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $2$ | $\sqrt{3}$ | $1$ | $-1$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $1$ |
| $y$ | $0$ | $1$ | $\sqrt{3}$ | $\sqrt{3}$ | $0$ | $-\sqrt{3}$ | $-\sqrt{3}$ |

$$

$$
